acceptanceCriteria: A cmd/corvint (or dogfoodflow) test drives `corvint dogfood finish` end to end over a fixture whose aggregate OCM refuses with map-too-large, too-many-claims and too-many-obligations, and asserts the stdout policy.evidence dogfood-ocm-status row carries the code plus a detail of at most 512 bytes naming totals, the bound and per-scope counts.
The same test asserts stderr still carries only the bare code (OCM-V0-022 split).
body: Filed 2026-10-15 from the batch 5 lane (PR #907, change 38e4e2858). OCM-V0-022 (V1-1048) is tested only at the aggregateRefusal helper; no end-to-end `dogfood finish` test exercises the evidence row and detail. Recorded as a limit in docs/build-log/2026-10-14-batch5-refusal-diagnostics.md and in the Codex round (finding kept, not fixed).
title: End-to-end dogfood finish test for OCM-V0-022 bound-refusal detail
